spans.s: mf(ज्वी॑)n. (√ अर्ज्, Uṇ. i, 28; probably fr. √ 2. ऋञ्ज्, col. 3 BRD.), tending in a straight direction, straight (lit. and fig.; opp. to वृजिन॑), upright, honest, right, sincere, RV.; AV. xiv, 1, 34; TS. &c., Mn.; MBh. &c.
(उ॑), ind. in the right manner, correctly, RV. ii, 3, 7; v, 46, 1; x, 67, 2; AitBr. iii, 3, 10
in a straight line, straight on Suśr. &c.
compar. ऋ॑जीयस्, RV. vii, 104, 12; AV. v, 14, 12; viii, 4, 12, and रजीयस्, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 162
superl. ऋजिष्ठ, Pāṇ., and र॑जिष्ठ, RV.
[observe that the metaphorical meaning of this word is more common in Vedic, and the literal meaning in classical literature]
(उस्), m. N. of a son of Vasu-deva, BhP.

etym.s: [cf. Zd. ĕrĕzu; Gk. ὀρέγω; Lat. rectus; Goth. raihts; Eng. right.]

ऋजू—√ कृ to straighten;
to set right, correct Comm. on RPrāt.

ऋ॑जू—नस् (ऋ॑जू˚), m. ‘straight-nosed’, N. of a man, RV. viii, 52, 2.
N. of a country (in which the river Vipāśā rises), Nir.
Nom. P. (p. ऋजूय॑त्) to walk straight-forward, be right or honest, RV. : Ā. (p. ऋजूय॑मान) to tend straight upward, RV. x, 88, 9.
in a straight line, RV. i, 183, 5.
upright, honest, RV. i, 20, 4.
